40020221.author: पदार्थः
40020221.content: अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, मुनिं to the sage, रामः Rama, कथं how, ते your, भ्रातरः brothers, वने in the forest, कीदृशं what kind, तु indeed, तदा then, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, तपः penance, तेपुः performed, महाबलाः the mighty ones

40020221.author: Translation
40020221.content: Then Rama asked the sage, "O Brahmana, how did your mighty brothers perform penance in the forest, and what kind of penance was it?"

40020222.author: पदार्थः
40020222.content: अगस्त्यः Agastya, तु indeed, अब्रवीत् spoke, तत्र there, रामं to Rama, सुप्रीतमानसम् with a very pleased mind, तान् तान् those various, धर्मविधीन् religious observances, तत्र there, भ्रातरः brothers, ते your, समाविशन् undertook

40020222.author: Translation
40020222.content: Agastya, with a very pleased mind, then spoke to Rama there, explaining that his brothers had undertaken various religious observances in that place.

40020223.author: पदार्थः
40020223.content: कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, ततः then, यत्तः diligent, नित्यम् always, धर्मपथे on the path of righteousness, स्थितः situated, तताप performed penance, ग्रीष्मकाले in the summer season, तु indeed, पञ्चाग्नीन् five fires, परितः around, स्थितः standing.

40020223.author: Translation
40020223.content: Then, Kumbhakarna, always diligent and situated on the path of righteousness, performed penance by standing amidst five fires during the summer season.

40020224.author: पदार्थः
40020224.content: मेघाम्बुसिक्तः drenched by rainwater, वर्षासु in the rainy season, वीरासनम् the hero's posture, असेवत he practiced, नित्यम् always, च and, शिशिरे in the cold, काले season, जलमध्यप्रतिश्रयः taking refuge in the middle of water.

40020224.author: Translation
40020224.content: In the rainy season, he practiced the Vīrāsana posture, drenched by rainwater, and always took refuge in the middle of water during the cold season.

40020225.author: पदार्थः
40020225.content: एवम् thus, वर्षसहस्राणि thousands of years, दश ten, तस्य for him, अतिचक्रमुः passed by, धर्मे in righteousness, प्रयतमानस्य striving, सत्पथे on the path of truth, निष्ठितस्य established, च and.

40020225.author: Translation
40020225.content: Thus, ten thousand years passed for him, who was striving in righteousness and firmly established on the path of truth.

40020226.author: पदार्थः
40020226.content: विभीषणः Vibhishana, तु but, धर्मात्मा righteous-souled, नित्यम् always, धर्मपरः devoted to righteousness, शुचिः pure, पञ्चवर्षसहस्राणि five thousand years, पादेन with a foot, एकेन one, तस्थिवान् he stood.

40020226.author: Translation
40020226.content: But Vibhishana, righteous-souled, always devoted to righteousness, and pure, stood on one foot for five thousand years.

40020227.author: पदार्थः
40020227.content: तस्य his, नियमे vow, समाप्ते when completed, अप्सरोगणाः the hosts of apsaras, ननृतुः danced, पुष्पवर्षं च and a rain of flowers, पपात fell, देवताः the gods, क्षुभिताश्चापि were also stirred (with joy).

40020227.author: Translation
40020227.content: When his austerity was completed, the hosts of apsaras danced, a rain of flowers fell, and the gods too were stirred with joy.

40020228.author: पदार्थः
40020228.content: पञ्चवर्षसहस्राणि five thousand years, सूर्यम् the sun, च and, एव indeed, अन्ववर्तत he worshipped, तस्थौ he stood, च and, ऊर्ध्वशिरोबाहुः with head and arms raised, स्वाध्यायधृतमानसः with mind fixed on self-study.

40020228.author: Translation
40020228.content: For five thousand years, he worshipped the sun, and he stood with his head and arms raised, his mind fixed on self-study.

40020229.author: पदार्थः
40020229.content: एवं thus, विभीषणस्यापि of Vibhishana also, स्वर्गस्थस्येव like one residing in heaven, नन्दने in Nandana (garden of Indra), दशवर्षसहस्राणि ten thousand years, गतानि passed, नियतात्मनः of him whose self was controlled (self-controlled)

40020229.author: Translation
40020229.content: In this manner, ten thousand years passed for the self-controlled Vibhishana, as if he were residing in the Nandana garden of heaven.

40020230.author: पदार्थः
40020230.content: दशवर्षसहस्रं ten thousand years, तु indeed, निराहारो without food, दशाननः Dashanana (Ravana), पूर्णे when completed, वर्षसहस्रे a thousand years, तु indeed, शिरश्चाग्नौ and his head into the fire, जुहाव offered as oblation, सः he

40020230.author: Translation
40020230.content: Dashanana (Ravana) fasted for ten thousand years, and upon the completion of each thousand years, he offered one of his heads into the fire as an oblation.

40020231.author: पदार्थः
40020231.content: एवं thus, वर्षसहस्राणि thousands of years, नव nine, तस्यातिचक्रमुः passed for him, शिरांसि heads, नव nine, चाप्यस्य and also of him, प्रविष्टानि entered, हुताशनम् the fire

40020231.author: Translation
40020231.content: In this manner, nine thousand years passed for him, and nine of his heads were offered into the fire.

40020232.author: पदार्थः
40020232.content: अथ then, वर्षसहस्रे in the thousand years, तु indeed, दशमे tenth, दशमं tenth, शिरः head, छेत्तुकामे desiring to cut off, दशग्रीवे when Dashagriva (Ravana), प्राप्तस्तत्र arrived there, पितामहः the grandfather (Brahma)

40020232.author: Translation
40020232.content: Then, in the tenth thousand-year period, as Dashagriva (Ravana) was about to cut off his tenth head, Lord Brahma arrived there.

40020233.author: पदार्थः
40020233.content: पितामहस्तु but the grandfather (Brahma), सुप्रीतः very pleased, सार्धं together with, देवैरुपस्थितः appeared with the gods, तव to you, तावद्दशग्रीव O Dashagriva, प्रीतो pleased, अस्मीत्यभ्यभाषत I am, thus he spoke

40020233.author: Translation
40020233.content: The grandfather (Brahma), greatly pleased, appeared there with the gods and addressed Dashagriva (Ravana), saying, "O Dashagriva, I am pleased with you."

40020234.author: पदार्थः
40020234.content: शीघ्रं quickly, वरय choose, धर्मज्ञ O knower of dharma, वरः boon, यः which, ते your, अभिकाङ्क्षितः desired, कम् what, ते your, कामम् desire, करोमि I do, अद्य today, न not, वृथा in vain, ते your, परिश्रमः effort.

40020234.author: Translation
40020234.content: Brahma tells Ravana, "O righteous one, quickly choose the boon you desire; what wish of yours shall I fulfill today, for your effort will not be in vain."

40020235.author: पदार्थः
40020235.content: अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, प्रहृष्टेन with delighted, अन्तरात्मना inner self, प्रणम्य having bowed down, शिरसा with head, देवम् to the god, हर्षगद्गदया with a voice choked with joy, गिरा with speech.

40020235.author: Translation
40020235.content: Then, Dashagriva, with a joyful heart, bowed his head to the god and spoke with a voice choked with happiness.

40020236.author: पदार्थः
40020236.content: भगवन् O Lord, प्राणिनाम् of living beings, नित्यम् always, न not, अन्यत्र elsewhere, मरणात् from death, भयम् fear, न not, अस्ति is, मृत्युसमः equal to death, शत्रुः enemy, अमरत्वम् immortality, अहम् I, वृणे choose.

40020236.author: Translation
40020236.content: Ravana addressed Brahma, stating that living beings constantly fear nothing but death, for there is no enemy equal to death, and therefore he desired immortality.

40020237.author: पदार्थः
40020237.content: एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken to, तदा then, ब्रह्मा Brahma, दशग्रीवम् to Dashagriva, उवाच said, ह indeed, न not, अस्ति is, सर्वामरत्वम् complete immortality, ते for you, वरम् boon, अन्यम् another, वृणीष्व choose, मे from me.

40020237.author: Translation
40020237.content: When thus addressed, Brahma then said to Dashagriva that complete immortality was not possible for him, and he should choose another boon from him.

40020238.author: पदार्थः
40020238.content: एवम् thus, उक्ते when spoken, तदा then, राम O Rama, ब्रह्मणा by Brahma, लोककर्तृणा by the creator of the worlds, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, उवाच said, इदम् this, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, अथ then, अग्रतः in front.

40020238.author: Translation
40020238.content: O Rama, when Brahma, the creator of the worlds, spoke thus, Dashagriva then, with folded hands before him, said the following.

40020239.author: पदार्थः
40020239.content: सुपर्णनागयक्षाणां of Suparnas, Nagas, and Yakshas, दैत्यदानवरक्षसाम् of Daityas, Danavas, and Rakshasas, अवध्यो invulnerable, अहं I, प्रजाध्यक्ष O Lord of creatures, देवतानां of gods, च and, शाश्वत O Eternal One.

40020239.author: Translation
40020239.content: Ravana declares to Brahma that he is invulnerable to Suparnas, Nagas, Yakshas, Daityas, Danavas, Rakshasas, and gods.

40020240.author: पदार्थः
40020240.content: नहि not indeed, चिन्ता concern, मम my, अन्येषु in other, प्राणिषु creatures, अमरपूजित O worshipped by immortals, तृणभूता like grass, हि indeed, ते those, मन्ये I consider, प्राणिनो creatures, मानुषादयः humans and others.

40020240.author: Translation
40020240.content: Ravana states that he has no concern for other creatures, especially humans and the like, whom he considers as insignificant as grass.

40020241.author: पदार्थः
40020241.content: एवम् thus, उक्तस्तु having been spoken to, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, दशग्रीवेण by Dashagriva, रक्षसा by the Rakshasa, उवाच spoke, वचनं words, देवः the god, सह with, देवैः the gods, पितामहः the grandfather.

40020241.author: Translation
40020241.content: Thus addressed by the Rakshasa Dashagriva, the righteous god Brahma, accompanied by other deities, spoke.

40020242.author: पदार्थः
40020242.content: भविष्यति it will be, एवम् thus, एतत् this, ते your, वचो word, राक्षसपुङ्गव O chief of Rakshasas. एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, तु indeed, तं to him, राम O Rama, दशग्रीवं to Dashagriva, पितामहः the grandfather.

40020242.author: Translation
40020242.content: Brahma granted Ravana's wish, saying, "So shall it be, O chief of Rakshasas," and having thus spoken to Dashagriva, O Rama, the grandfather continued.

40020243.author: पदार्थः
40020243.content: शृणु listen, च and, अपि also, वरो boon, भूयः further, प्रीतस्य of the pleased one, इह here, शुभः auspicious, मम my. हुतानि offered, यानि which, शीर्षाणि heads, पूर्वम् formerly, अग्नौ in the fire, त्वया by you, अनघ O sinless one.

40020243.author: Translation
40020243.content: Brahma further offered an auspicious boon, asking Ravana to listen, regarding the heads he had previously offered into the fire.

40020244.author: पदार्थः
40020244.content: पुनः again, तानि those, भविष्यन्ति will be, तथैव just so, तव your, राक्षस O Rakshasa, वितरामि I grant, इह here, ते to you, सौम्य O gentle one, वरं boon, च and, अन्यं another, दुरासदम् difficult to obtain.

40020244.author: Translation
40020244.content: O Rakshasa, those (heads) will be yours again just as before, and here I grant you, O gentle one, another formidable boon.

40020245.author: पदार्थः
40020245.content: छन्दतः according to your will, तव your, रूपं form, च and, मनसा by mind, यत् whatever, यथा as, ईप्सितम् desired, भविष्यति will be, न not, सन्देहः doubt, मद्वरात् from my boon, तव your, राक्षस O Rakshasa.

40020245.author: Translation
40020245.content: O Rakshasa, whatever form you desire in your mind will be yours according to your will, without a doubt, by virtue of my boon.

40020246.author: पदार्थः
40020246.content: एवं thus, पितामह by the grandfather, उक्तस्य spoken to, दशग्रीवस्य of Dashagriva, रक्षसः of the Rakshasa, अग्नौ in the fire, हुतानि offered, शीर्षाणि heads, पुनः again, तानि those, उत्थितानि arose, वै indeed.

40020246.author: Translation
40020246.content: Thus, to Dashagriva, the Rakshasa, who was addressed by the grandfather (Brahma), those heads that had been offered into the fire indeed arose again.

40020247.author: पदार्थः
40020247.content: एवं thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, तु indeed, तं to him, राम O Rama, दशग्रीवं to Dashagriva, पितामहः the grandfather, विभीषणम् to Vibhishana, अथ then, उवाच spoke, वाक्यं words, लोकपितामहः the grandfather of the worlds.

40020247.author: Translation
40020247.content: O Rama, having thus spoken to Dashagriva, the grandfather of the worlds (Brahma) then spoke these words to Vibhishana.

40020248.author: पदार्थः
40020248.content: विभीषण O Vibhishana, त्वया by you, वत्स O dear child, धर्मसंहितबुद्धिना by one whose intellect is joined with righteousness, परितुष्टः greatly pleased, अस्मि I am, धर्मात्मन् O righteous-souled one, वरं boon, वरय choose, सुव्रत O virtuous one.

40020248.author: Translation
40020248.content: O Vibhishana, O dear child, I am greatly pleased by you, O righteous-souled one, whose intellect is aligned with dharma; therefore, O virtuous one, choose a boon.

40020249.author: पदार्थः
40020249.content: विभीषणस्तु Vibhishana, however, धर्मात्मा the righteous-souled one, वचनं words, प्राह spoke, साञ्जलिः with folded hands, वृतः surrounded, सर्वगुणैः by all good qualities, नित्यं always, चन्द्रमा the moon, रश्मिभिर्यथा as by its rays.

40020249.author: Translation
40020249.content: The righteous Vibhishana, always adorned with all virtues like the moon surrounded by its rays, spoke with folded hands.

40020250.author: पदार्थः
40020250.content: भगवन् O Lord, कृतकृत्यो having accomplished my purpose, अहं I am, यन्मे because to me, लोकगुरुः the preceptor of the world, स्वयम् himself, प्रीतेन pleased, यदि if, दातव्यो is to be given, वरो a boon, मे to me, शृणु listen, सुव्रत O one of good vows.

40020250.author: Translation
40020250.content: O Lord of good vows, I am fulfilled because the preceptor of the world himself is pleased with me; if a boon is to be granted to me, please listen.

40020251.author: पदार्थः
40020251.content: परमापद्गतस्यापि even when fallen into extreme distress, धर्मे in righteousness, मम my, मतिर्भवेत् mind should be, अशिक्षितं untaught, च and, ब्रह्मास्त्रं the Brahmastra, भगवन् O Lord, प्रतिभातु may it appear/manifest, मे to me.

40020251.author: Translation
40020251.content: O Lord, may my mind always remain fixed on righteousness even in the greatest calamity, and may the Brahmastra manifest to me even without formal instruction.

40020252.author: पदार्थः
40020252.content: या या whatever, मे my, जायते arises, बुद्धिर् intellect/thought, येषु येष्वाश्रमेषु in whichever stages of life, च and, सा सा that, that (same), भवतु may it be, धर्मिष्ठा most righteous, तं तु that, however, धर्मं righteousness, च and, पालये may I protect/observe.

40020252.author: Translation
40020252.content: May whatever thoughts arise in my mind, in whichever stage of life, always be righteous, and may I always uphold that righteousness.

40020253.author: पदार्थः
40020253.content: एष this, मे my, परमोदार most noble, वरः boon, परमको supreme, मतः considered, नहि indeed not, धर्माभिरक्तानां for those devoted to righteousness, लोके in the world, किञ्चन anything, दुर्लभम् difficult to obtain.

40020253.author: Translation
40020253.content: This is considered my most noble and supreme boon, for indeed, nothing is difficult to obtain in this world for those who are devoted to righteousness.

40020254.author: पदार्थः
40020254.content: पुनः again, प्रजापतिः Prajapati, प्रीतः pleased, विभीषणम् to Vibhishana, उवाच said, ह indeed, धर्मिष्ठः righteous, त्वम् you, यथा as, वत्स dear child, तथा so, च and, एतत् this, भविष्यति will be

40020254.author: Translation
40020254.content: Prajapati, being pleased, again said to Vibhishana, "As you are righteous, dear child, so shall this be."

40020255.author: पदार्थः
40020255.content: यस्मात् because, राक्षसयोनौ in the demon lineage, ते your, जातस्य having been born, अमित्रनाशन O destroyer of enemies, न not, अधर्मे in unrighteousness, जायते arises, बुद्धिः intellect, अमरत्वम् immortality, ददामि I give, ते to you

40020255.author: Translation
40020255.content: Because, O destroyer of enemies, though born in a demon lineage, your mind does not incline towards unrighteousness, I grant you immortality.

40020256.author: पदार्थः
40020256.content: इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, कुम्भकर्णाय to Kumbhakarna, वरम् a boon, दातुम् to give, उपस्थितम् who was ready, प्रजापतिम् to Prajapati, सुराः gods, सर्वे all, वाक्यम् words, प्राञ्जलयः with folded hands, अब्रुवन् said

40020256.author: Translation
40020256.content: Having thus spoken, when Prajapati was about to grant a boon to Kumbhakarna, all the gods, with folded hands, spoke to him.

40020257.author: पदार्थः
40020257.content: न not, तावत् then, कुम्भकर्णाय to Kumbhakarna, प्रदातव्यः should be given, वरः a boon, त्वया by you, जानीषे you know, हि indeed, यथा how, लोकान् the worlds, त्रासयति frightens, एषः this, दुर्मतिः evil-minded one

40020257.author: Translation
40020257.content: "A boon should not be granted by you to Kumbhakarna at this time, for you indeed know how this evil-minded one terrorizes the worlds."

40020258.author: पदार्थः
40020258.content: नन्दने in Nandana, अप्सरसः Apsaras, सप्त seven, महेन्द्रानुचराः followers of Mahendra, दश ten, अनेन by him, भक्षिताः devoured, ब्रह्मन् O Brahman, ऋषयः sages, मानुषाः humans, तथा and also

40020258.author: Translation
40020258.content: O Brahman, by him, seven Apsaras in Nandana, ten followers of Mahendra, as well as sages and humans, have been devoured.

40020259.author: पदार्थः
40020259.content: अलब्धवरपूर्वेण by one who had not previously obtained a boon, यत् whatever, कृतं was done, राक्षसेन by the demon, तु indeed, तत् that, एषः this one, वरलब्धः having obtained a boon, स्यात् would be, भक्षयेत् would devour, भुवनत्रयम् the three worlds.

40020259.author: Translation
40020259.content: Whatever was done by the demon before he obtained a boon, this demon, now having obtained a boon, would indeed devour the three worlds.

40020260.author: पदार्थः
40020260.content: वरव्याजेन by the pretext of a boon, मोहः delusion, अस्मै to him, दीयताम् let it be given, अमितप्रभ O one of immeasurable splendor, लोकानां for the worlds, स्वस्ति welfare, च and, एवं thus, स्यात् may it be, भवेत् may it be, अस्य his, च and, सन्नतिः downfall.

40020260.author: Translation
40020260.content: O one of immeasurable splendor, let delusion be given to him under the guise of a boon, and thus there would be welfare for the worlds and his downfall.

40020261.author: पदार्थः
40020261.content: एवम् thus, उक्तः addressed, सुरैः by the gods, ब्रह्मा Brahma, अचिन्तयत् thought, पद्मसम्भवः born from a lotus, चिन्तिता having been thought of, च and, उपतस्थे approached, अस्य his, पार्श्वं side, देवी goddess, सरस्वती Saraswati.

40020261.author: Translation
40020261.content: Thus addressed by the gods, Brahma, born from a lotus, pondered, and as he thought, the goddess Saraswati approached his side.

40020262.author: पदार्थः
40020262.content: प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, सा she, तु indeed, पार्श्वस्था standing by the side, प्राह spoke, वाक्यं words, सरस्वती Saraswati, इयम् here, अस्मि I am, आगता arrived, देव O god, किं what, कार्यं task, करवाणि shall I do, अहम् I.

40020262.author: Translation
40020262.content: Standing by his side with folded hands, Saraswati spoke these words: "Here I am, O god, arrived; what task shall I perform?"

40020263.author: पदार्थः
40020263.content: प्रजापतिः the lord of creation, तु indeed, तां to her, प्राप्तां who had arrived, प्राह spoke, वाक्यं words, सरस्वतीम् to Saraswati, वाणि O Saraswati, त्वं you, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य of the king of demons, भव become, या who, देवता deity, ईप्सिता desired.

40020263.author: Translation
40020263.content: The lord of creation then spoke these words to Saraswati, who had arrived: "O Saraswati, you become the desired deity of the king of demons."

40020264.author: पदार्थः
40020264.content: तथेति having said 'so be it', उक्त्वा having said, प्रविष्टा entered, सा she, प्रजापतिः Prajapati, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, कुम्भकर्ण O Kumbhakarna, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, वरम् a boon, वरय choose, यः which, मतः is desired.

40020264.author: Translation
40020264.content: After Saraswati entered, Prajapati Brahma then addressed Kumbhakarna, the mighty-armed one, telling him to choose whatever boon he desired.

40020265.author: पदार्थः
40020265.content: कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, तु indeed, तत् that, वाक्यम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, वचनम् a word, अब्रवीत् spoke, स्वप्तुम् to sleep, वर्षाणि years, अनेकानि many, देवदेव O God of gods, मम my, ईप्सितम् desired.

40020265.author: Translation
40020265.content: Hearing those words, Kumbhakarna then spoke, saying, "O God of gods, it is my desire to sleep for many years."

40020266.author: पदार्थः
40020266.content: एवम् thus, अस्तु let it be, इति thus, तम् him, च and, उक्त्वा having said, प्रायात् went away, ब्रह्मा Brahma, सुरैः with the gods, समम् together with, देवी Goddess, सरस्वती Saraswati, च and, एव indeed, राक्षसम् the demon, तम् him, जहौ abandoned, पुनः again.

40020266.author: Translation
40020266.content: Having said "So be it" to him, Brahma departed with the gods, and Goddess Saraswati then abandoned that demon.

40020267.author: पदार्थः
40020267.content: ब्रह्मणा by Brahma, सह with, देवेषु when the gods, गतेषु had gone, च and, नभःस्थलम् to the sky, विमुक्तः released, असौ he, सरस्वत्या by Saraswati, स्वाम् his own, सञ्ज्ञाम् consciousness, च and, ततः then, गतः attained.

40020267.author: Translation
40020267.content: When Brahma and the gods had ascended to the sky, Kumbhakarna, released by Saraswati, then regained his own consciousness.

40020268.author: पदार्थः
40020268.content: कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, तु indeed, दुष्टात्मा the evil-minded one, चिन्तयामास thought, दुःखितः distressed, ईदृशम् such, किम् what, इदम् this, वाक्यम् word, मम my, अद्य today, वदनात् from the mouth, च्युतम् uttered.

40020268.author: Translation
40020268.content: The evil-minded Kumbhakarna, now distressed, pondered, "What kind of words have I uttered from my mouth today?"

40020269.author: पदार्थः
40020269.content: अहं I, व्यामोहितो deluded, देवैः by the gods, इति thus, मन्ये I think, तदा then, आगतैः who had come, एवम् thus, लब्धवराः having obtained boons, सर्वे all, भ्रातरः brothers, दीप्ततेजसः of blazing splendor, श्लेष्मातकवनम् to the Shlesmataka forest, गत्वा having gone, तत्र there, ते they, न्यवसन् resided, सुखम् happily

40020269.author: Translation
40020269.content: I believe I was deluded by the gods who had come then; thus, all the brothers, having obtained boons and possessing blazing splendor, went to the Shlesmataka forest and resided there happily. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे दशमः सर्गः ।। 10 ।। Thus ends the tenth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
